title: Making inference 11x faster: what actually costs time in MicroPython
question: Where do 13 ms go for 104 multiply-accumulates, and can the policy fit 200 Hz?
headline: 18125 us -> 1607 us, 32% of budget, duty error 0.0018. Two results invert the usual instincts: a float tanh lookup table is SLOWER than calling exp(), and inlining the weights as literals was worth more than the float-to-integer conversion.
